description: Acterys Matrix Gen 2 redefines planning and forecasting in Power BI by combining exceptional performance, flexibility, and usability in one powerful visual. Purpose-built for advanced FP&A and enterprise use cases, this Power BI planning matrix supports direct data entry, write-back, bulk splashing, and DAX-based rollups—giving teams everything they need to plan and act with confidence. Designed to handle complex scenarios, Acterys Matrix Gen 2 supports both top-down and bottom-up planning in Power BI, along with advanced formatting, validation, and export capabilities. Whether you're modeling next quarter’s projections or consolidating enterprise-wide plans, this visual empowers you to deliver real-time insights backed by secure data processes. Fully integrated with Acterys’ platform and ERP systems like Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, and NetSuite, it enables seamless forecasting and scenario planning in Power BI. Key Features: Flexible Data Entry & Allocation: Plan at any level with intuitive controls and smart allocation options like “Fill to end of period” or “Same to every child.” DAX Rollup Aggregations: Use Power BI DAX rollups for consistent, dynamic hierarchies and reporting.
